_comment: Where to look for jobs. Edit feeds/searches freely. Remote-only: every search below carries the source's own remote filter; antiKeywords in skills.json push down on-site/hybrid postings that slip through.
_minScoreComment: Cold applications must clear a HIGH bar (much stricter than inbound replies) so you only apply to strong frontend matches, not spray-and-pray. Raise to be pickier, lower for more results.
_excludeTitleComment: Job titles containing any of these whole words are skipped before scoring (no application package), across all sources. Used to drop entry-level roles. Matched in the title only, so senior roles that merely mention these words in the description are kept.
_excludeLocationComment: Boards also list vacancies physically located abroad (DOU marks them 'за кордоном', Jooble UA carries 'Краків, Польща' etc). Jobs whose location contains any of these substrings (case-insensitive) are dropped across ALL sources before scoring.
_llmComment: LLM re-scoring + tailored cover letters via the local Claude CLI (claude -p). The LLM NEVER gates: keyword minScore/requireRole decide what gets a package; the LLM only ranks, explains, and writes the letter. Any CLI failure silently falls back to keyword-only packages. maxPerRun caps CLI calls per run.

dou._comment: Official DOU RSS feeds. ?remote keeps only remote-friendly postings; category/search mirror the site's filters.

djinni._comment: Public Djinni jobs board, read with a plain fetch (no login, no browser). Each search is a full jobs-search URL — copy them from your browser's filters (set 'Remote' there and copy the URL if the employment param ever changes). primary_keyword=JavaScript is Djinni's front-end category; Fullstack and Node.js widen the net. fullDescription (default true) follows each job link for the complete text so scoring is accurate; set false to score on the listing snippet only.

jooble._comment: Jooble via its official API on the Ukrainian market (apiHost ua.jooble.org — every vacancy is applyable from Ukraine). Keys are market-bound: the FREE key from ua.jooble.org/api/about goes into the JOOBLE_API_KEY env var (set it in run-jobs.sh, which is gitignored — never put the key here). Each search is { keywords, location }: ''=all of Ukraine, 'віддалено'=remote only, or a city like 'Київ'. The score gate + excludeTitle still filter results.
jooble._minScoreComment: Per-source override of the global minScore. Jooble's API returns only short snippets, which score ~5-8 points lower than full descriptions, so it gets a lower bar.

workua._comment: Work.ua public jobs board, server-rendered — read with a plain fetch (no login, no browser). Each search is a full jobs-search URL; jobs-remote-<query> filters to remote-only, e.g. https://www.work.ua/jobs-remote-react/ (copy from your browser). fullDescription (default true) follows each job link for the complete text. Disabled: general-market board, local-SMB tail — DOU/Djinni cover the UA tech market.

robota._comment: Robota.ua sits behind Cloudflare, which hard-blocks headless Chrome — this source only yields results when jobs.mjs runs with HEADFUL=1 (it is skipped with a log hint otherwise). Fetched through the same Playwright browser as LinkedIn, no login needed. Each search is a full search URL (copy from your browser); params;scheduleIds=3 filters to remote — verify the filter in the browser, it changes occasionally. fullDescription (default true) opens each vacancy page for the complete text — slower, keep maxResults modest. Disabled: same general-market tail as Work.ua, plus needs manual HEADFUL runs.

linkedin._comment: Scraping LinkedIn job search violates ToS and is more detectable. Kept modest: few results, polite delays. remote:true adds the f_WT=2 filter. Locations cover the target markets: Ukrainian companies, EU, US — all remote. Set enabled=false to turn off.
